packs.name: Pixel Heaven
packs.description: Bright, floaty major 7 and minor 9 loops that drift like a menu screen at 3am.

packs.name: Starlight Arcade
packs.description: Video-game plugg: sparkly arps, chromatic side-steps and bonus-level key changes.

packs.name: Honey Static
packs.description: Sugar-coated R&B chords for plugg drums: maj9s, m11s, secondary dominants and the minor iv.

packs.name: Velvet Slide
packs.description: Slash-chord pluggnb and slow ballad loops with bass lines that walk under the voicings.

packs.name: Graveyard Bloom
packs.description: Dark plugg: minor-major sevenths, Phrygian flat twos and altered dominants under bright bells.

progressions.title: Cloud Save
progressions.description: IVmaj9 down the scale to a borrowed bIIImaj9 that lifts the loop back to the top. Bounce it under a half-time plugg pattern.

progressions.title: Starfruit Sky
progressions.description: Eight bars that step down from IVmaj9 and land on a hanging Bb13sus4 before the second half. Long held pads for a slow plugg glide.

progressions.title: Lilac Respawn
progressions.description: IV-iii-ii walked down in rich extensions, then a sus4 that resolves inside the bar. Arp it on a bell or music box.

progressions.title: Floating Hearts
progressions.description: Am9 with a bright Lydian ninth gives this its glow before a C9sus4 that never quite resolves. Low and wide under thin hats.

progressions.title: Mana Fountain
progressions.description: Imaj9 to iii and IV, then the minor iv pulls the third down a half step for that bittersweet plugg turn. Eighth-note pulse on a soft synth.

progressions.title: Bubble Gate
progressions.description: ii9-V13 into iii, with a Bbmaj7 chromatic neighbour slipping in at the end. Stab it so the drums have room.

progressions.title: Glimmer Shore
progressions.description: A descending IV-iii-ii with F over Eb as the hinge, then a second pass that ends on a b9 pickup. Slow-rolled keys for a drifting eight-bar loop.

progressions.title: Sugar Orbit
progressions.description: Long IV and vi chords with quick passing ones, the last a bVImaj9 that drops in from nowhere. Bounce rhythm on a glassy pluck.

progressions.title: Halo Garden
progressions.description: IV to minor iv over the same bass, then I in first inversion and a ii11. Classic plugg melancholy, held out on a warm pad.

progressions.title: Snowglobe Sleep
progressions.description: Minor plugg loop that stays on minor sevenths, with the v as a soft m11 instead of a dominant. Arp it slowly on a celesta.

progressions.title: Kite Signal
progressions.description: IVmaj9 to iv, down to iii and a quick vi-V13 turnaround. Pulse eighths on a saw pluck at a fast tempo.

progressions.title: Ice Cream Moon
progressions.description: Eight bars of IV-iii-ii-V in the warmest key, the second half landing on vi11 and a suspended V. Held pads, let the reverb do the work.

progressions.title: Coin Heaven
progressions.description: IV to V over a held C bass, then iii to vi. Arp it on a square-wave lead for that title-screen feel.

progressions.title: Bonus Stage
progressions.description: Stepwise IV-iii-ii, then V over a D bass for a lift, ending on a Dmaj7-over-E into E13. Eight bars that loop back cleanly.

progressions.title: Level Select
progressions.description: i-VI-iv with a minor v that slides down a half step to Bbmaj7 before the loop. Held keys, best under a soft bell lead.

progressions.title: Extra Life
progressions.description: IV to V6/9, then a D7#9 (the V of vi) that snaps into Gm9. Stab pattern on a chiptune pluck.

progressions.title: Pause Menu
progressions.description: Eight quick chords, two beats each: down the scale, the minor iv as a colour, and a b9 dominant to turn it around. Busy harmony that still sits back.

progressions.title: Crystal Cavern
progressions.description: i-VI-III-iv, then a Neapolitan Dmaj9 into a G#7b9 that pulls hard back to the top. Arp it on glassy bells for a cave-level mood.

progressions.title: Hover Board
progressions.description: IV to minor iv, then a chromatic bass walk F# to F to E through a diminished passing chord into ii-V. Pulse it fast.

progressions.title: Gemstone Lobby
progressions.description: Each bar of the home key answered by a borrowed chord a third away: Abmaj9 then Dbmaj9. Rolled keys for a shop-menu kind of glow.

progressions.title: Daydream Cartridge
progressions.description: VI to III in first inversion, iv9 and a full V7b9 that wants the tonic but loops before it gets there. Held under a vocal chop.

progressions.title: Comet Tail
progressions.description: i9-VImaj9-iv11 with a Bb7#9 that adds bite on the last bar. Stab it on a bright synth so the darkness stays underneath.

progressions.title: Sky Lantern
progressions.description: VI-iv-i with a suspended V that resolves its fourth on beat three. Bounce rhythm under airy flute or bell.

progressions.title: Neon Pixel Rain
progressions.description: First half is a minor i-VI-iv-V; the second climbs through III and VII over D before a Neapolitan Dbmaj9 and an altered V. Eight bars for a big hook.

progressions.title: Sweet Tooth Static
progressions.description: IVmaj9-iii7-vi9 with a D9 secondary dominant, then the second pass turns iii into E7#9 and ends on the minor iv. Classic pluggnb sugar.

progressions.title: Lip Gloss Loop
progressions.description: Two-chord feel: a long IVmaj9 to vi9, pushed by a quick altered V of vi. Leave space for the vocal.

progressions.title: Rose Quartz Text
progressions.description: The IVmaj7-iii7-vi9 move, then minor iv and a suspended V to set up the loop. Rolled Rhodes on top of plugg drums.

progressions.title: Pink Lemon Haze
progressions.description: VI-V7#9-i, a walking Eb6 over G, then a minor ii-V into Fm11. Eight bars of sweet-dark R&B chords for a slow pluggnb vocal.

progressions.title: Satin Slushie
progressions.description: IVmaj9-iii7-vi9, an A9 secondary dominant and the minor iv right behind it. Pulse it on a soft electric piano.

progressions.title: Heart Emoji
progressions.description: A long VImaj9 squeezed into an altered V, landing on i9 and iv9. Bounce it so the altered chord hits on the pickup.

progressions.title: Velour Hoodie
progressions.description: IV-iii-vi with an F#9 (the V of V) and the minor iv to close. Short stabs, low register, room for 808s.

progressions.title: Butterfly Clip
progressions.description: IVmaj9 to a D7#9 into vi, a bass walk down to ii11, then minor iv and a quick double turnaround. Eight bars for a full verse.

progressions.title: Strawberry Pager
progressions.description: IVmaj9 to an F7#9 (the V of vi) into vi9, then a sus V and the minor iv. Bounce it on a bright Rhodes.

progressions.title: Cherry Soda Pulse
progressions.description: IVmaj9, the altered V of vi, vi11 and the minor iv. Four chords that sound like a whole R&B song.

progressions.title: Bubblegum Ringtone
progressions.description: IVmaj9 into the V of vi, vi11, then a ii-V13 to turn around. Arp the upper voices on a music box.

progressions.title: Mood Ring Glow
progressions.description: Two long bars of VImaj9, then an altered V into i11. Mostly space, perfect for a sung hook.

progressions.title: Slow Dance Signal
progressions.description: Pluggnb ballad: IV-iii-vi with the bass stepping down to A, a ii-V, then I in first inversion, the minor iv and a sus V. Roll it slowly.

progressions.title: Mirror Curtains
progressions.description: VImaj9 to V in first inversion so the bass climbs Eb-F#-G, then walks back down F-Eb. Held keys under a moody pluggnb vocal.

progressions.title: Fogged Pixel Pane
progressions.description: VImaj9 to VII over the same F, then v down to i and a bass walk to G. Rolled piano, slow and wet.

progressions.title: Satin Elevator
progressions.description: IV-iii-vi into V over A, then I over D climbing to the minor iv and a ii11-V13 close. Slow ballad loop, eight bars.

progressions.title: Porch Light Ballad
progressions.description: IV down to I in first inversion, ii11 and a suspended V that darkens to b9. Roll it slowly on a felt piano.

progressions.title: Pearl Drop Text
progressions.description: VImaj9 to V7#9 to i9, then a bass walk Bb-Ab-Gb that brings the loop back to the top. Held, lush and a little sad.

progressions.title: Rain On Satin
progressions.description: i9-VImaj9-iv11 and a full V7b9 in a dark key. Rolled keys, slow, under a falsetto hook.

progressions.title: Silk Notification
progressions.description: VImaj9 turns minor, then III over G steps into a quick iv9-V7#9. Held pad, sweet chords with a cold edge.

progressions.title: Late Bloom Ballad
progressions.description: VImaj9 to an altered V into i9, then the bass falls to E to loop. A slow ballad at plugg tempo, rolled.

progressions.title: Cashmere Voicemail
progressions.description: IVmaj9-iii7-vi9, a Bb9 over D (the V of V) and the minor iv. Push each chord an eighth early for the R&B lean.

progressions.title: Velvet Stairwell
progressions.description: VImaj9 to V in first inversion so the bass rises C-D#-E, then steps back down D-C. Pushed chords on a dark Rhodes.

progressions.title: Afterglow Duet
progressions.description: A bass line walking Bb-C#-D-C, then Gm9 down to F and a Neapolitan Ebmaj9 into an altered V. An eight-bar pluggnb ballad.

progressions.title: Cemetery Arcade
progressions.description: i9 to a Lydian VImaj7#11, iv11 and a b9 dominant. Arp it on toy bells for dark plugg that still sparkles.

progressions.title: Ghost Respawn
progressions.description: A minor-major ninth to a Lydian bVI, iv9 and a crunchy E7#9. Bounce it for haunted, fast plugg.

progressions.title: Haunted Wifi
progressions.description: i9 to VImaj9 and the Phrygian bIImaj7#11 before a b9 dominant. Held pads that hang in the air.

progressions.title: Tombstone Glitter
progressions.description: i9-VImaj9-iv11 and a suspended V that resolves to b9 for extra tension. Stab it on a cold digital pluck.

progressions.title: Spider Silk Dream
progressions.description: A minor-major ninth, VImaj9#11, iv11 and a b13 dominant whose G pulls back into the tonic. Slow arp, eerie and pretty.

progressions.title: Bones In Bloom
progressions.description: i-VI-iv-V with Lydian and b9 colour, then the tonic turns minor-major and a Phrygian Abmaj9 darkens the second half. Eight bars, held.

progressions.title: Crypt Lullaby
progressions.description: Long i9 and iv11 chords, each answered by a quick passing chord: a Lydian VI and a b9 V. Rolled like a broken music box.

progressions.title: Hex Key
progressions.description: i9, a Lydian VI, iv9 and a gritty F#7#9. Pulse eighths on a detuned saw for a darker plugg bounce.

progressions.title: Black Glitter
progressions.description: A minor-major ninth, VImaj9, the Phrygian bIImaj9 and a crunchy V7#9. Stabs at a fast tempo, very spacey.

progressions.title: Wraith Lobby
progressions.description: i9-VI-iv-V, then the tonic goes minor-major and a Phrygian Gmaj9 drops in before an altered V. Bounce it for an eerie eight-bar loop.

progressions.title: Coffin Candy
progressions.description: Sweet-and-sour: i9, a Lydian VImaj7#11, iv11 and a b9 dominant. Held on a soft pad, dark plugg with a sugar coating.

progressions.title: Shadow Save File
progressions.description: i9, a Lydian bVI, iv11 and a b13 dominant whose Gb leans into the tonic. Arp it like a haunted game menu.
